sloka: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे रामं सुग्रीवो ऽपि महाबलः ।प्रणम्य विधिवद्वीरं विज्ञापयितुमुद्यतः ।। ७.१०८.२३ ॥
transliteration: etasminnantare rāmaṁ sugrīvo 'pi mahābalaḥ ।praṇamya vidhivadvīraṁ vijñāpayitumudyataḥ ।। 7.108.23 ॥

translations.english: Meanwhile, the mighty Sugriva also, having properly bowed to the hero Rama, prepared to make a submission.
